Ontogeny — School of Excellence (2021).

A heraldic crest for a school. An open book — the oldest symbol of learning — cradled in two cupped hands inside an academic shield, ringed by laurel and topped with a crown. 'Ontogeny' is the growth of a living thing from its earliest form: knowledge held and nurtured, not just displayed.

Drawn for four registers — forest green, deep black, reversed white and a warm sepia — so one emblem could carry a blazer badge, a gate sign and a certificate alike.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·73.
